subject: math
title: Shapes and Their Attributes: Sides, Corners, Faces and Cubes
seo_title: Grade 2 Shapes Worksheets: Triangles, Quadrilaterals, Pentagons, Hexagons and Cubes (2.G.A.1)
standard_text: Recognize and draw shapes having specified attributes, such as a given number of angles or a given number of equal faces. Identify triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, and cubes.
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 shapes worksheets with pictures: count sides and corners, name triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons and hexagons, find shapes with given attributes, and count the faces, edges and vertices of a cube. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Count the sides to name a shape: 3 triangle, 4 quadrilateral, 5 pentagon, 6 hexagon.
key_sub: A shape has as many corners as sides. Size, turning and uneven sides never change the name. A cube has 6 square faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
body_html:
Count sides and corners

A side is one straight line of a flat shape. A corner is where 2 sides meet. Another word for corner is vertex. Every corner makes an angle.

To count, put your finger on one corner. Go around the shape and count each side or corner once. Stop when you are back at the start.

Example

A shape has 6 sides. How many corners and angles does it have?

Sides and corners always match: 6 corners. There is 1 angle at each corner: 6 angles.

Answer: 6 corners and 6 angles

The name comes from the number of sides

ShapesNameSidesCorners
triangle33
quadrilateral44
pentagon55
hexagon66

A stop sign has 8 sides. A shape with 8 sides is an octagon. A circle has no straight sides and no corners.

Cubes: faces, edges and vertices

A cube is a solid, like a die. It is not flat.

WordWhat it meansA cube has
facea flat surface6 faces, all the same square
edgewhere 2 faces meet12 edges
vertexa corner where edges meet8 vertices
SolidFacesEdgesVertices
Cube (all faces are the same square)6128
Rectangular prism (a box like a cereal box)6128
Example

In a picture of a cube, you can see 3 faces. How many faces does the cube have?

3 faces are on the back, the bottom and one side. You cannot see them. 3 + 3 = 6.

Answer: 6 faces

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the first corner again at the endStop when you get back to the corner where you started
Calling a turned square a diamond, not a quadrilateralCount the sides: 4. Turning never changes the name
Thinking a hexagon must have equal sidesAny closed shape with 6 straight sides is a hexagon
Thinking a bigger shape has more sidesSize does not matter. Count the sides
Saying a cube has 3 facesCount the hidden faces too: a cube has 6
Mixing up faces, edges and verticesFace = flat surface, edge = line where faces meet, vertex = corner

faq.q: What shapes should a 2nd grader know?
faq.a: Grade 2 students should know triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons and cubes (Common Core 2.G.A.1). They name each flat shape by counting its sides and corners.

faq.q: How many faces, edges and vertices does a cube have?
faq.a: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. All 6 faces are squares of the same size.

faq.q: Does a hexagon have to have equal sides?
faq.a: No. Any closed flat shape with 6 straight sides is a hexagon, even if the sides are different lengths. The same rule works for triangles, quadrilaterals and pentagons.

faq.q: What is the difference between a side and a vertex?
faq.a: A side is a straight line of the shape. A vertex is a corner, the point where 2 sides meet.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each side once: 3 sides. It is a triangle.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each corner once, and stop when you are back at the start: 3 corners. It is a triangle. Turning a shape does not change how many corners it has.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each side once: 4 sides. It is a quadrilateral.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each corner once, and stop when you are back at the start: 4 corners. It is a square, turned. A square is a quadrilateral. Turning a shape does not change how many corners it has.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each side once: 4 sides. It is a quadrilateral.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each side once: 5 sides. It is a pentagon.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each corner once, and stop when you are back at the start: 5 corners. It is a pentagon.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each side once: 6 sides. It is a hexagon.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each corner once, and stop when you are back at the start: 6 corners. It is a hexagon. Turning a shape does not change how many corners it has.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each corner once, and stop when you are back at the start: 4 corners. It is a quadrilateral.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. Count each side once: 5 sides. It is a pentagon. Turning a shape does not change how many sides it has.

items.q: How many angles does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. There is 1 angle at each corner. 4 corners make 4 angles. It is a quadrilateral.

items.q: How many angles does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner and go around the shape. There is 1 angle at each corner. 6 corners make 6 angles. It is a hexagon. Turning a shape does not change how many angles it has.

items.q: How many sides and corners does this shape have?
items.e: Count the sides: 3. Count the corners: 3. A flat shape with straight sides always has the same number of sides and corners. If you get 4 corners, you counted the first corner again.

items.q: How many sides and corners does this shape have?
items.e: Count the sides: 5. Count the corners: 5. A flat shape with straight sides always has the same number of sides and corners. If you get 6 corners, you counted the first corner again.

items.q: How many corners does a circle have?
items.e: A circle is round all the way around. It has no straight sides, so there are no corners: 0.

items.q: Shape A is big. Shape B is small. Which has more sides?
items.e: Both are triangles with 3 sides. Size does not change the number of sides.

items.q: A corner is where 2 ___ meet.
items.e: A side is one straight line of a shape. A corner (vertex) is the point where 2 sides meet.

items.q: A shape has 4 sides. How many corners does it have?
items.e: Each side ends at a corner, and each corner joins 2 sides. A flat shape has the same number of corners as sides: 4.

items.q: Sam draws a shape with 6 corners. How many angles does it have?
items.e: There is 1 angle at every corner. 6 corners make 6 angles. Do not add corners and angles together.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 3. A shape with 3 sides is a triangle. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 3. A shape with 3 sides is a triangle. The sides do not have to be the same length. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 3. A shape with 3 sides is a triangle. The sides do not have to be the same length. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 4. A shape with 4 sides is a quadrilateral. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 4. A shape with 4 sides is a quadrilateral. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 4. It is a square that is turned, and every square is a quadrilateral.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 4. A shape with 4 sides is a quadrilateral. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 5. A shape with 5 sides is a pentagon. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 5. A shape with 5 sides is a pentagon. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 5. A shape with 5 sides is a pentagon. Turning a shape does not change its name.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 6. A shape with 6 sides is a hexagon. Count the corner that points in, too.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 6. A shape with 6 sides is a hexagon. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 6. A shape with 6 sides is a hexagon. The sides do not have to be the same length.

items.q: What is the name of this shape?
items.e: Count the sides: 6. A shape with 6 sides is a hexagon. Count the corner that points in, too.

items.q: Noah says this is not a hexagon because the sides are not the same length. Is he right?
items.e: Count the sides: 6. Any closed shape with 6 straight sides is a hexagon. The sides can be different lengths.

items.q: Jack says this shape is a diamond, not a quadrilateral. Is he right?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral. It is a square standing on a corner. Turning does not change its name.

items.q: A shape has 5 sides. What is it called?
items.e: Penta means 5. A shape with 5 sides is a pentagon. A hexagon has 6 sides.

items.q: How many sides does a hexagon have?
items.e: Hexa means 6. A hexagon has 6 sides and 6 corners. (A pentagon has 5 and an octagon has 8.)

items.q: A shape has 3 corners. What is it?
items.e: 3 corners means 3 sides. Tri means 3, so it is a triangle.

items.q: What does quad in quadrilateral tell you?
items.e: Quad means 4. A quadrilateral has 4 sides. The sides do not have to be equal.

items.q: Which shape has no corners?
items.e: Shape B is a circle. It is round, with no straight sides and no corners.

items.q: Which shape has the most sides?
items.e: Shape D is the smallest shape, but it has the most sides: 6. Count the sides. Do not look at the size.

items.q: A shape has more than 4 sides but fewer than 6 sides. What is it?
items.e: More than 4 and fewer than 6 is 5. A shape with 5 sides is a pentagon.

items.q: Which shape has more sides than a square?
items.e: Shape B is a hexagon with 6 sides. A square has 4. The others have 4, 3 and 4 sides, so they do not have more.

items.q: Which shape has fewer corners than a square?
items.e: Shape D is a triangle with 3 corners. A square has 4. The others have 5, 6 and 4 corners.

items.q: How many more sides does a hexagon have than a triangle?
items.e: A hexagon has 6 sides and a triangle has 3. 6 − 3 = 3 more sides.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 5 sides, so it is a pentagon. The other three have 4 sides, so they are quadrilaterals.

items.q: Which has more corners, a triangle or a hexagon?
items.e: A triangle has 3 corners. A hexagon has 6 corners. 6 is more than 3.

items.q: Which shape has 6 angles?
items.e: Shape C is a hexagon. It has 6 corners, and each corner has an angle: 6 angles.

items.q: Which shape is a hexagon?
items.e: Shape B has 6 sides, so it is a hexagon. It does not look like a honeycomb, but count the sides: 6. The others have 5, 5 and 4 sides.

items.q: Which shape has exactly 5 corners?
items.e: Shape C is a pentagon with 5 corners. The others have 6, 4 and 3 corners.

items.q: Which shape has 1 more side than a square?
items.e: Shape C has 5 sides: 1 more than the 4 sides of a square. It is a pentagon.

items.q: How many more corners does a pentagon have than a quadrilateral?
items.e: A pentagon has 5 corners and a quadrilateral has 4. 5 − 4 = 1 more corner.

items.q: Which shape has 3 sides?
items.e: Shape A has 3 sides, so it is a triangle, even though it is turned. A circle has no sides.

items.q: Which shape is a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape D has 4 sides, so it is a quadrilateral. The sides are not equal, and that is fine.

items.q: Which has fewer sides, a pentagon or a quadrilateral?
items.e: A quadrilateral has 4 sides and a pentagon has 5. 4 is fewer than 5.

items.q: How many corners do a square and a triangle have in all?
items.e: A square has 4 corners and a triangle has 3. 4 + 3 = 7 corners.

items.q: Does a flat shape with straight sides always have the same number of sides and corners?
items.e: Every side ends at a corner, and every corner joins 2 sides. So a triangle has 3 and 3, a hexagon has 6 and 6.

items.q: Which shape has 2 more sides than a quadrilateral?
items.e: Shape A has 6 sides. A quadrilateral has 4, and 4 + 2 = 6. It is a hexagon. (The 8-sided shape is an octagon.)

items.q: What is the fewest straight sides a closed shape can have?
items.e: 2 straight sides cannot close up. With 3 sides you can make a closed shape: a triangle.

items.q: How many faces does a cube have?
items.e: A face is a flat side. You can see 3 faces, but there are 3 more on the back, the bottom and the left: 3 + 3 = 6.

items.q: How many edges does a cube have?
items.e: An edge is where 2 faces meet. There are 4 edges on the front, 4 on the back and 4 going from front to back: 12. The dashed lines are edges you cannot see, so count them too.

items.q: How many vertices (corners) does a cube have?
items.e: A vertex is a corner where edges meet. There are 4 on the front and 4 on the back: 8. One vertex is hidden at the back, where the dashed lines meet.

items.q: What is the red part called?
items.e: The red part is a flat surface of the cube. A flat surface of a solid is called a face.

items.q: What is the red line called?
items.e: The red line is where 2 faces meet. That is an edge.

items.q: What is the red dot on?
items.e: The dot is on a corner where 3 edges meet. A corner of a solid is a vertex. (Two or more are vertices.)

items.q: What shape is each face of a cube?
items.e: Every face of a cube is a square, and all 6 squares are the same size.

items.q: How many faces of this cube can you see?
items.e: You can see the front, the top and the right side: 3 faces. The other 3 faces are hidden.

items.q: How many faces does this box have?
items.e: This solid is a rectangular prism. It has a front and back, a top and bottom, and a left and right side: 6 faces.

items.q: How many edges does this box have?
items.e: 4 edges on the front, 4 on the back and 4 joining them: 12. Count the 3 dashed edges too.

items.q: How many vertices does this box have?
items.e: 4 vertices on the front and 4 on the back: 8. One of them is hidden.

items.q: How is a cube different from this box?
items.e: Both have 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A cube's 6 faces are all the same square. This box has long and short faces.

items.q: Which solid is a cube?
items.e: Picture C has 6 faces that are all the same square. One shape is a flat square, not a solid. The long box has faces that are not all squares, and the pyramid has triangle faces.

items.q: Which solid is NOT a cube?
items.e: Solid A is a tall box. Its front is not a square, so its faces are not all the same. The other three are cubes: one is small and one is drawn from the left, but size and turning do not matter.

items.q: How many edges meet at each vertex of a cube?
items.e: At every corner of a cube, 3 edges meet: one going up or down, one going side to side and one going back.

items.q: Which word means a flat surface of a solid?
items.e: A face is a flat surface. An edge is where 2 faces meet. A vertex is a corner.

items.q: A cube has 6 faces. You can see 3 faces. How many faces are hidden?
items.e: 6 − 3 = 3. The hidden faces are the back, the bottom and one side.

items.q: A cube has 12 edges. In a picture, 9 edges are solid lines. The rest are dashed. How many are dashed?
items.e: 12 − 9 = 3. Dashed lines show the edges you cannot see.

items.q: Is a square the same as a cube?
items.e: A square is a flat shape with 4 sides. A cube is a solid with 6 square faces.

items.q: A cube has 8 vertices. You can see 7 in this picture. How many are hidden?
items.e: 8 − 7 = 1. The hidden vertex is at the back, where the 3 dashed edges meet.

items.q: A stop sign has 8 sides. What shape is it?
items.e: Octa means 8, like the 8 legs of an octopus. A shape with 8 sides is an octagon. A hexagon has only 6.

items.q: A slice of pizza has 2 straight sides and 1 curved crust. Which shape does it look most like?
items.e: It has 3 corners and 3 sides, so it looks most like a triangle. It is not a true triangle, because the crust is curved. The whole pizza is a circle.

items.q: I have 6 sides and 6 corners. What shape am I?
items.e: 6 sides make a hexagon. A cube has 6 faces, not 6 sides, and it is a solid.

items.q: I have 3 sides and 3 corners. What shape am I?
items.e: 3 sides make a triangle. Do not add the sides and the corners: it has 3 sides, not 6.

items.q: I am a solid with 6 faces. Every face is the same square. What am I?
items.e: A solid with 6 faces that are all the same square is a cube. A square is flat, and a hexagon is flat.

items.q: A yield sign has 3 sides. What shape is it?
items.e: 3 sides make a triangle.

items.q: Home plate on a baseball field has 5 sides. What shape is it?
items.e: 5 sides make a pentagon. Home plate looks like a house drawn upside down.

items.q: Each cell in a honeycomb has 6 sides. What shape is each cell?
items.e: 6 sides make a hexagon.

items.q: A door is a rectangle. Which shape group does a rectangle belong to?
items.e: A rectangle has 4 sides, so it is a quadrilateral.

items.q: A die is a number cube. Each face has a different number of dots. How many faces have dots?
items.e: A die is a cube, and a cube has 6 faces. That is why a die shows 1 to 6.

items.q: A cereal box has 6 faces. Some faces are big and some are small. Is it a cube?
items.e: A cube needs 6 faces that are all the same square. The cereal box has faces of different sizes, so it is not a cube.

items.q: Mia draws a house: a square with a triangle roof that fits the top. She traces only the outside line. How many sides does the outline have?
items.e: The square gives 3 outside sides (left, bottom, right). The roof gives 2. The line between them is inside. 3 + 2 = 5 sides: a pentagon.

items.q: Omar cuts a square from one corner to the opposite corner. What 2 shapes does he get?
items.e: The cut goes corner to corner. Each piece has 3 sides, so you get 2 triangles.

items.q: Emma cuts one corner off a square with one straight cut. How many sides does the paper have now?
items.e: The cut takes away 1 corner and makes 2 new corners: 4 − 1 + 2 = 5 corners. 5 corners means 5 sides. It is a pentagon now.

items.q: Kai draws a shape with 4 sides. Ben draws a shape with 1 more side. What shape did Ben draw?
items.e: 4 + 1 = 5 sides. A shape with 5 sides is a pentagon.

items.q: Eli says every hexagon looks like a honeycomb cell. Is he right?
c: Yes, or it is a pentagon
items.e: Any closed shape with 6 straight sides is a hexagon. The sides can be different lengths, and it can look long or bent.

items.q: How many corners do 2 triangles have in all?
items.e: Each triangle has 3 corners. 3 + 3 = 6 corners.

items.q: Lily uses 1 straw for each side. She makes a pentagon. How many straws does she use?
items.e: A pentagon has 5 sides, so Lily needs 5 straws.

items.q: Nora builds a cube. She uses a stick for each edge. How many sticks does she need?
items.e: A cube has 12 edges, so Nora needs 12 sticks. (8 is the number of corners, and 9 is how many edges you can see.)

items.q: Then Nora puts a ball of clay on each corner of the cube. How many clay balls does she need?
items.e: A cube has 8 vertices (corners): 4 on the top and 4 on the bottom.
